newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African activist Boesak's trial postponed.
newsitem.headline: S.African activist Boesak's trial postponed.

text.p: The trial of South African anti-apartheid activist Allan Boesak on 32 charges of theft and fraud involving more than nine million rand ($1.9 million) was on Monday postponed to September 15.
Boesak appeared briefly in the Cape Town High Court and was not asked to plead. The state did not oppose the postponement.
Boesak, a church minister, has insisted that he is innocent of 21 charges of theft and nine of fraud involving foreign aid intended for the poor.
He was in the forefront of anti-apartheid campaigners during the 1980s but was accused three years ago by a Danish aid agency of having embezzled funds given to his Foundation for Peace and Justice.
Boesak is standing trial with the foundation's former bookkeeper, Freddie Steenkamp, but his lawyers have asked that the two should be tried separately.
